html:
The Czech Republic, or Czechia, is a landlocked country in Central Europe, independent since 1 January 1993, when Czechoslovakia split in two. Its capital is Prague.

Its core is the old Kingdom of Bohemia, with Moravia to the east. Bohemia was a leading state of the Holy Roman Empire; Prague was the imperial capital under Charles IV in the 14th century, and the reformer Jan Hus preached there. The Habsburgs ruled it from 1526 until 1918, when it became the heart of Czechoslovakia.

After the Velvet Revolution of 1989 ended communist rule, the playwright Václav Havel became president. Czech and Slovak leaders then agreed the peaceful dissolution of Czechoslovakia, and Slovakia went its own way. The Czech Republic joined NATO in 1999 and the European Union in 2004, and is one of the most industrial economies in Europe.
sum: The Czech Republic, or Czechia, is a landlocked country in Central Europe, independent since 1 January 1993, when Czechoslovakia split in two. Its capital is Prague.
